title: Concept: Maven dependency declared with a version range
description: pom.xml declares a dependency version written as a range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A range resolves to whatever matching release exists on the day of the build, so two builds of the same pom can compile different code.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: A range resolves to whatever matching release exists on the day of the build, so two builds of the same pom can compile different code.
